title: tooling-gaps: moeb read_file absolute:true cannot reach Claude Code tool-results directory used for fix_signal overflow output
description: When the fix_signal MCP tool produces output exceeding the token limit, the Claude Code harness writes the result to C:\Users\<user>\.claude\projects\<id>\tool-results\. This path is outside the project root and OS temp directory — both the allowed roots for mcp__moeb__read_file with absolute:true. The agent was forced to use the external Read tool to process the overflow result, triggering a moeb-tool-origin failure. moeb generates overflow files it cannot read back with its own tools.
proposed_resolution: Extend mcp__moeb__read_file absolute path allowed roots to include the Claude Code projects directory (resolved from a well-known env var or config), or add a dedicated read_tool_result tool that accepts a run-scoped job ID and reads the overflow file by path.
